sentences.quote: Ghazi worked with de Geus and the leadership team for 25+ years, most recently as COO and President, and he has led their AI journey via Synopsys.ai beginning in 2017. Before joining Synopsys in 1998 as an applications engineer, he began his career as a design engineer at Intel.
sentences.text: He began his career as a design engineer at Intel before joining Synopsys in 1998 as an applications engineer, and spent more than 25 years working alongside de Geus and the leadership team, most recently as COO and President, while leading the company's AI journey through Synopsys.ai from 2017.

As CEO he has continued de Geus's strategy and long-term vision, with capital allocation priorities of reinvesting in the business, typically tuck-in M&A and opportunistic buybacks, though repurchases are temporarily paused to pay down debt from the $35bn Ansys acquisition until leverage falls below 1x debt to adjusted EBITDA.

mgmt_bio.text: Sassine Ghazi became chief executive of Synopsys after co-founder Aart de Geus retired at the end of 2023 and moved to the role of executive chairman. He began his career as a design engineer at Intel before joining Synopsys in 1998 as an applications engineer, and spent more than 25 years working alongside de Geus and the leadership team, most recently as COO and President, while leading the company's AI journey through Synopsys.ai from 2017.
